name: 1688 B2B工厂店主图与详情页图片包

prompt_template.main_image_rules: square marketplace images; product-led composition; reserve platform-safe space; use only verified short copy and evidence
prompt_template.detail_page_rules: mobile-first vertical e-commerce infographics; each screen resolves one procurement question with labeled evidence or a clearly marked placeholder
prompt_template.fact_safety: Do not invent prices, MOQ, lead times, capacity, certifications, inspection results, customer logos, ratings, sales, or service commitments. Omit unknown facts or label them as placeholders for confirmation.
prompt_template.asset_integrity: Preserve the supplied product's shape, color, material, markings, parts, quantity, and proportions. Use real supplied assets for product, production, and inspection claims whenever available.
prompt_template.negative_constraints: no illustrative styling; no product-category-specific props or terminology unless supplied by the user; no fabricated text, logo, seal, certificate, data chart, or procurement claim

defaults.main_image_product_coverage: 35-45% unless the supplied product needs a different verified presentation
defaults.whitespace: 45%+ for main images and 50%+ for detail pages
defaults.copy_policy: Use short, readable placeholders only until the user confirms copy and factual claims.
defaults.evidence_policy: Claims about product, factory, inspection, delivery, or service require user-supplied evidence; otherwise use an explicit placeholder or omit the claim.

main_images.question_answered: What is being sourced and for which procurement context?
main_images.layout: product-led hero with a short verified headline placeholder and reserved platform-safe space

main_images.question_answered: What is included, selectable, or within scope?
main_images.layout: clear labeled overview using only supplied product assets

main_images.question_answered: What observable quality evidence supports the product?
main_images.layout: real macro or process evidence with concise callouts

main_images.question_answered: Where or by whom is the product used?
main_images.layout: credible supplied application image or neutral contextual diagram

main_images.question_answered: Can the buyer inspect the supplied item clearly?
main_images.layout: clean white or neutral background, minimal copy, unobstructed product view

detail_pages.question_answered: What sourcing need does this product address?
detail_pages.layout: E-commerce infographic overview with verified headline, product, and 3-4 short evidence labels

detail_pages.question_answered: What can be verified about construction or material?
detail_pages.layout: E-commerce infographic with supplied macro evidence and labeled callouts

detail_pages.question_answered: Which product features matter to the buyer?
detail_pages.layout: two-column benefit infographic; each benefit tied to a verified feature

detail_pages.question_answered: What must be checked before ordering?
detail_pages.layout: open specification layout with confirmed fields only; unknown fields remain placeholders

detail_pages.question_answered: How is the product used or deployed?
detail_pages.layout: numbered steps or scenario panels based only on confirmed usage information

detail_pages.question_answered: What happens after inquiry or order confirmation?
detail_pages.layout: process diagram using user-confirmed steps only; leave unverified stages as placeholders

detail_pages.question_answered: What evidence exists for quality handling or fulfillment?
detail_pages.layout: evidence-first panel using supplied factory, inspection, packaging, or shipping assets; no fabricated badges

detail_pages.question_answered: What information should the buyer provide next?
detail_pages.layout: clean CTA panel with an inquiry checklist and confirmation placeholders, never unverified commercial terms

evidence-first.description: 优先呈现实拍产品、材料、工艺、工厂或质检证据

overrides.visual_priority: real evidence assets before decorative visuals

customization-inquiry.description: 适用于需确认规格、文件、样品或服务边界的询盘路径

overrides.detail_emphasis: confirmation checklist, supplied workflow evidence, and explicit placeholders for commercial terms

ready-stock-procurement.description: 适用于现货采购，但所有库存与交付信息必须由用户确认

overrides.detail_emphasis: product scope, configuration verification, and inquiry requirements; do not assume availability or terms

category_tips.general: Keep all category-specific specifications, safety statements, performance claims, and application claims tied to user-provided facts and assets.
category_tips.industrial: Prioritize model, material, dimensions, interface, operating context, and inspection evidence when confirmed.
category_tips.consumer_goods: Prioritize material, included items, care or use guidance, packaging scope, and real product detail when confirmed.
category_tips.components: Prioritize dimensions, compatibility conditions, tolerances, drawing references, and batch-identification evidence when confirmed.

examples: Create a 1688 B2B factory-store image pack for {product_description}. Use only {verified_product_and_service_facts} and {available_product_factory_and_inspection_assets}. Build M01-M05 and D01-D08 from the defined structure. Mark missing copy, specifications, commercial terms, and evidence as placeholders. No illustrative styling, fabricated claims, or product-category assumptions.

E-commerce infographic specification screen for {product_description}. Use a mobile-first two-column layout, supplied product image, and confirmed specification labels only. Unknown values appear as 「待确认」 placeholders. Product occupies 35%; whitespace 50%+. No fabricated data, seals, prices, MOQ, or delivery promises.
anti_ai_tips: Use supplied product and evidence images as references. Keep labels short and proof-oriented. Do not generate pseudo-certificates, dense tables with invented values, artificial factory scenes presented as evidence, or extra product parts.
